items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: Montoull, [sic] he could read, but he could play.

ctx.x: What about Montoull? [Montudi (Garland)] Who was that, a bass player, probably a very active man with many bands.
Montoull, [sic] he could read, but he could play.
He could play but he couldn't read or he could read?
